job.title: Research Scientist, Foundation Models and Multimodal AI

strengths: Hands-on fine-tuning of foundation models for Turkish NLP tasks
Design of cross-modal alignment methods in research projects
Strong Python and PyTorch experience with published AI work
gaps: No documented experience with biological omics data

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Committee,

I am a computer engineer and lecturer who has spent the last few years adapting large language models for Turkish text summarisation and clinical AI evaluation. In my PhD work I built hybrid pipelines that combine extractive summarisation with LLMs, fine-tuning open-source transformers on domain-specific data. This directly matches your need for model adaptation and optimisation.

At Toros University I led a project that aligned textual and visual representations for a medical reporting tool, using contrastive learning and unified embedding spaces. The system integrated structured patient data, images and free-text notes, showing that I can design multimodal architectures similar to CLIP-style models.

My research has produced several peer-reviewed papers on trustworthy AI and multimodal NLP, and I regularly use Python, PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem. I have also contributed to COST research networks where I handled large multimodal datasets and built evaluation pipelines that assess model reliability and generalisation.

I look forward to bringing this blend of research depth and practical engineering to Owkin's K Pro platform. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Anıl Kuş
short_pitch: I adapt foundation models for domain-specific NLP and have built multimodal pipelines that fuse text, images and structured data for medical AI, using Python, PyTorch and Hugging Face.

answers.why_this_role: The role combines fine-tuning of foundation models with multimodal integration, exactly the work I have done in my PhD and research projects on hybrid summarisation and clinical AI evaluation.
answers.why_this_organisation: Owkin's focus on AI for biology matches my interest in trustworthy medical AI, and the collaborative, international environment reflects my experience coordinating academic networks across Europe and Turkey.
answers.relevant_experience: I have fine-tuned transformer models for Turkish summarisation, built cross-modal alignment architectures for medical reporting, and created benchmarking pipelines to evaluate model reliability on clinical data.
answers.research_interests: My research aims to make AI systems explainable and ready for real-world medical use, especially by combining language models with other data modalities such as images and structured health records.
answers.additional_information: I have led academic departments, co-founded a technology centre, and mentored students in AI, demonstrating leadership and teamwork skills.
